falsifiers.claim: no identity producer exists on the Work route
falsifiers.observation: the worker block mints sessionId: brandString(`worker-${randomUUID()}`) and, with that minting expression removed, mentions NO session identity; the block contains no process.send at all; the only process.send in the host bundle is the context-pull tool, whose envelope carries no session identity
falsifiers.expectedInvariant: the Work route must transport the created session identity to the parent

falsifiers.claim: the parent has no Session Identity parser
falsifiers.observation: spawned.on("message") consults only parseWorkerPullEnvelope and drops every other message via `if (envelope === undefined) return;`; no identity channel constant, parser or observation type exists
falsifiers.expectedInvariant: a correctly shaped identity message must be recognized on the parent IPC channel

falsifiers.claim: the parent already owns the invocation identity
falsifiers.observation: const invocationId = `wpi-${randomUUID()}` is minted BEFORE spawn and carried on the port observation; the parent owns the spawned object
falsifiers.expectedInvariant: the receiving parent must associate an identity with its OWN invocation, never a payload-supplied one

falsifiers.claim: Work Delegation already owns Attempt correlation
falsifiers.observation: correlateObservations stamps prepared.attemptId (canonical Work) and adopts observation.invocationId from the producer; the blocking kernel supplies hostLocalJobId "" rather than inventing one
falsifiers.expectedInvariant: AttemptId comes from Work and InvocationId from the port

falsifiers.claim: session creation and the model turn are separate
falsifiers.observation: in runWorker the order is create -> capabilityRefusal check -> handle.agent -> followup; in the installed dsh-agent-loop, createStoredSession precedes setupAndPublish, and AgentRegistry refuses an agent whose id disagrees with its session id
falsifiers.expectedInvariant: a session-created observation must be possible without any model turn

falsifiers.observation: the observer sink is best-effort (a throw is swallowed); the port records executable identity as digests; the observation itself publishes HOST_OBSERVATION_DOES_NOT_PROVE including "that a downstream wrapper spawned the genuine DSH binary"
falsifiers.expectedInvariant: receipt on the IPC channel must not be reported as first-party provenance

falsifiers.observation: package.json engines.node is >=24.15.0; the measured runtime is v24.14.1, so the declared minimum is NOT met; the installed DSH build is 0.2.0-rc.2
falsifiers.expectedInvariant: a P2-A runtime verdict must disclose the runtime limitation

note: every falsifier is measured against the exact P2-A baseline before any product behaviour changed
